primitives.name: Run Expectancy Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Two runs seemed like a safe lead, but we were anxious to increase it.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R_e': 'Expected runs scored in current inning state', 'S': 'Score differential (positive for leading team)', 'T': 'Time remaining in game (inning count)'}
primitives.assumptions: Run expectancy is a function of base configuration and score differential; linear dependence on time remaining.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When S < 0 or T approaches zero, kernel becomes degenerate.

layer2.mapping: GSI models R_e as conditional probability distribution over base states; GSE simulates transitions between these states via discrete Markov chains.

primitives.name: Base Running Dynamics
primitives.verbatim_quote: Denny stole third by a desperate slide, having gone to second on a throw home which failed to catch Matthews.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'B_r': 'Base running success rate', 'T_h': 'Throw accuracy (home plate to catcher)', 'S_d': 'Slide desperation index (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Success depends on timing, speed, and error margin in throw execution.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T_h > 0.95, B_r drops below threshold due to high defensive precision.

layer2.mapping: GSI encodes B_r as a logistic regression outcome; GSE maps to dynamic pathfinding algorithms for runner positioning.
layer2.telemetry: Runner advancement percentage per stolen base attempt.

primitives.name: Pitch Sequence Outcome
primitives.verbatim_quote: Two balls were pitched, and then he hit a beauty into left center for a home-run!
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_s': 'Sequence of pitches (ball/strike counts)', 'H_o': 'Hit outcome (single, double, HR, etc.)', 'V_p': 'Velocity profile of pitch (mph)'}
primitives.assumptions: Outcome is deterministic given pitch sequence and batter skill level.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When P_s exceeds 3 balls or 3 strikes, H_o becomes undefined.

layer2.mapping: GSI computes H_o likelihood using pitch classification; GSE simulates trajectory via kinematic equations.
layer2.telemetry: Home run rate per pitch sequence type.
